allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Finkurve Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "Intimation of Press Release regarding receipt of ₹30 Crore towards exercise and conversion of Share Warrants".

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Finkurve Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on November 24, 2025, wherein the Board approved raising of funds through issuance of NCD on private placement basis via EBP portal for an amount not exceeding Rs. 50,00,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Crore Only).
